title: token-lattice-ca: a cellular automaton over token space as a black-box measurement instrument for language models
description:
A ring of token cells resampled in place by a language model's own windowed conditional, with common-random-number coupling so that undamaged copies diverge by exactly zero and damage spreading becomes measurable.

The repository is both the instrument and its research record. findings.md is a dated ledger that keeps retracted and amended findings in place rather than deleting them, with the correction stated where the claim was made. Several entries are corrections of other entries; that is the design, and a citation should carry the amendment with the finding.

Code is MIT (LICENSE); the prose, the findings ledger and results/ as accompanying data are CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-docs). Zenodo records a single licence field, which is the software one.

Accompanies arXiv:2608.10986 (cs.CL).
